vasya.title: Vasya — assistant
vasya.voiceFailed: Unable to read the question aloud. You can still read it and reply by voice or text.
vasya.autoApply: Voice answers automatically update the card.
vasya.intro: Hi! Tell me about your task: what happens today and what would you like to change? I will create a card and ask clarifying questions.
vasya.manual: Describe the context and I will add it to the form. Save the draft to start the clarification dialogue.
vasya.complete: Your answers have been applied. Review the card or request more questions.

title: Project cards
subtitle: Turn a business need into a clear task for student teams.
empty: No cards yet. Start by describing your task.
placeholder: For example: we track requests in a spreadsheet and want to reduce processing time…
descriptionHint: At least 10 characters. The assistant will extract fields and ask clarifying questions. Check the text before submitting.
saved: Draft saved. Select Save and evaluate to update the rating.
evaluated: Card saved, rating and reward recalculated.
published: Card published and available to student teams.
readOnly: Completed, cancelled and in-progress tasks cannot be edited.
tagsError: Unable to load tags. Existing selections are preserved; retry loading.

company.title: Introduce your company
company.description: Enter the name of the company that will publish tasks.
company.name: Company name

voice.error: Unable to record or transcribe. Check microphone access and retry, or enter text manually.

questions.automatic: Reply to Vasya by voice or enter text. Leaving the answer field automatically saves it and updates the card.
questions.title: Clarify your task
questions.description: The assistant asks at least three questions per round. Answer what you know, apply your answers and evaluate the card. Continue clarifying below 40 points; above that, add details as needed.
questions.applied: Answers saved and applied. Check the fields, then save and evaluate.

rating.title: Task readiness
rating.stale: Save and evaluate the current fields: these changes have no confirmed rating yet.
rating.explanation: Readiness uses 7 criteria. The reward is calculated separately from difficulty. A low rating does not prevent publishing or proposals.

confirm.title: Confirm publication
confirm.description: “{{title}}” will be available to all student teams. Review its fields and contact details in the editor.
confirm.check: I have reviewed the information and confirm publication

leave.title: Unsaved changes
leave.description: Leaving now will discard your changes in the editor.

errors.invalid_fields: Check custom field names and values: numbers, URLs and JSON must match the selected type.
errors.card_generation_failed: Unable to create an AI draft. Your description is still in the form. Retry or fill in manually.
errors.card_review_failed: Card saved, but AI evaluation failed. Retry Save and evaluate.
errors.clarification_generation_failed: Unable to generate questions. Retry or continue editing manually.
errors.clarification_apply_failed: Answers saved, but could not be applied to the card. Retry applying.
errors.card_review_required: Evaluate the current card before publishing.
errors.card_not_editable: This card cannot be edited or published in its current status.
errors.card_changed: The card changed in another window. Reopen it before continuing.
errors.company_already_exists: Company already created. Reload the page.
errors.invalid_tags: Some tags are no longer available. Reload the list.
errors.duplicate_field_keys: Custom field keys must be unique.
